pilots.selection_rule: among verified rows with a proven native-snapshot restore and a nonzero known footprint, minimize known local bytes
among verified rows with a proven native-snapshot restore and a nonzero known footprint, maximize known local bytes
among rows requiring >=2 GPUs or holding >=50 GB artifacts or >=20B parameters, prefer the strongest evidence tier, then the largest artifact/parameter size

sources.sanitization: whitelisted fields only; private registry paths, container env, and free-text blockers removed

provenance.note: Digest-pinned images come from lane manifests; artifact/cache byte counts and timings come from the pre-T0 storage audit and timing tables in COLD_START_METRICS.md. Timings are seconds. gpu_sku_evidence records the SKU the evidence was measured on, not a support matrix.

local.default_model_catalog in modules/nims/catalog.tf. The module only requests nvidia.com/gpu counts; no GPU SKU is bound anywhere in the module. All entries default enabled=false, replicas=1, port 8000, cache under /opt/nim/.cache. Version 'latest' means the module deploys an unpinned tag.
Models named in repository documentation or example configurations without a deployable catalog entry or any recorded run evidence. These are candidates, never inventory.

storage_feasibility.method: low bound sums only source-recorded image/artifact/cache bytes; high bound adds the observed nearest-rank p90 image size (11717475483 B) per missing image size and p90 artifact size (99959572798 B) per missing artifact size. Artifact sizes are unknown for most Forge rows because manifests record them only when onboarding measured them; treat the high bound as a planning ceiling, not a measurement.
